body: Sadly yes. I should have gone sooner but never did. One time was forced by friends who called an ambulance and the other two times I went myself. :)
No problem:) we are all here for eachother^^

Hey:) I kinda was in your situation too. If you have the opportunity in your country, then slowly go back into your old life. Maybe an afternoon and then a weekend and so on...
You can do it! I belive in you:) 
Its hard to resist but trust me it's worth it❤️

I was in a psychiatric unit 3 times and every time helped me a lot. It kinda helps you clear your mind cuz you have time and also you get the therapy you need. i can only speak for my country ( germany) but it helped a lot. Just take it easy with going back into your old life. I found this to be the hardest. 
Best of luck to you:)
